title: Writing to console
description: Now, it is time for you to combine eveything. Print string 1 and 2 to console, then exit with code 0.
starterCode:
section .data
    msg db "LHINX booted!", 10
    len equ $ - msg
    msg2 db "System started", 10
    len2 equ $ - msg2

section .text
    global _start

_start:
hint:
**Write (rax = 1)** - print to screen
- `rdi` = 1 (stdout)
- `rsi` = address of your string
- `rdx` = length of string
